scope: One numeric sphere-pair reference point, source edit, project reopen and native history trial; not complete M4 acceptance.

native.savedRecordReadback: The indexed point span decodes to coordinates [12,6,7], mode 3, submode 1 and two source identities. Sphere payloads were not decoded.
native.oneSourceControl: A From primitives point with only the first sphere selected stored [0,0,0] and one source identity; this is not a separate center-mode test.

historyTrial.sequence: Reopen the saved project, change Sphere(1) center X from 9 to 5, accept, then invoke Undo and Redo without opening another editor in between.
historyTrial.undo: Sphere(1) disappeared from the history tree; Sphere(2) and both reference points remained. Undo became disabled and Redo enabled. The point's geometry during this intermediate state was not inspected.
historyTrial.redo: Sphere(1) reappeared at the end of history. The point editor displayed [10,6,7] and both sphere names.
historyTrial.limitation: This one sequence differs from the application undo of a source rebuild; the native undo stack's internal semantics and intermediate point geometry are unverified.

application.result: Independent GUI and public MCP point creation matched [10,6,7]; rebuilding the first sphere refreshed both to [12,6,7]. Application undo, redo and project-worker reopen preserved both definitions and expected coordinates.
application.cleanup: The bounded 4 GiB Job passed with zero active children, closed handles, released validation lane and closed private browser and MCP ports.

limits: Native viewport geometry and selection were not visible in capture.
The one native history trial does not establish undo/redo parity or general native history semantics.
This comparison does not establish general source-provider, curve, sketch or milestone parity.
